_nota: Fuente: Marcos 2:1-12 (también Lucas 5:17-26, que habla de tejas). Casas de Galilea del siglo I: techos de vigas, ramas y barro (arqueología de Cafarnaúm). Nunca se muestra el rostro de Jesús.
tech01-techo: four ancient men on a flat mud roof of a stone house digging a hole in the roof, crowd below, sunlight, Galilee
tech02-cafarnaum: the ancient fishing village of Capernaum on the shore of the Sea of Galilee with black basalt stone houses, morning light, epic wide view
tech03-multitud: a crowd of ancient people packed at the doorway of a small stone house in a village, seen from outside, dust, warm light
tech04-camilla: four ancient men carrying a paralyzed man on a simple straw mat stretcher through a village street, seen from behind, warm light
tech05-como: cross section illustration of an ancient Galilean house roof made of wooden beams, branches and packed mud, warm light
tech06-barro: close up of hands pulling apart branches and dried mud from a roof, light coming through the hole, dust falling
tech07-bajan: interior of a crowded small ancient stone house seen from inside, a square hole torn open in the wooden beam and branch roof, bright beams of sunlight falling through the hole, dust in the air, people seen from behind looking up
tech08-fe: silhouettes of four friends looking down through a hole in a roof, golden light from below, dust
tech09-camina: a crowd of amazed ancient Galilean villagers standing outside the door of a small black basalt stone house, seen from behind, warm sunlight, dusty village street
tech10-final: four friends sitting on a flat roof at sunset in an ancient village, seen from behind, golden sky
